equity_bridge.note: H1 FY2026 interim balance sheet, 30 June 2026 (RMB 332,130k). Charged once here; flows are consolidated.

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: Base-case five-year average revenue growth (4.0/3.5/3.0/3.0/3.0), anchored to revenue_3yr_cagr 5.0% and H1 FY2026 +4.5%, haircut for related-party contract attrition and fee regulation. Equity CAGR is unusable: owners' equity was negative FY2021-FY2023 after the RMB 13.4bn deposit seizure, so the 3-year figure is undefined and the 5-year figure (-30%) measures the write-off, not the business.
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity, EPS and FCF CAGRs all diverge from revenue by far more than 30% because FY2020-21 are the pre-collapse related-party years (FY2020 EPS RMB 0.26 on high-margin developer VAS; FY2021 OCF RMB 4.5bn included the pledged-deposit build) and FY2021-23 equity is negative. Only the 3-year revenue CAGR (5.0%) and 3-year owner-FCF CAGR (17.6%, off a depressed FY2022 base) describe the current business.
historical_growth.notes: Owner-FCF series (reported FCF less interest income; SBC nil): FY2020 3,051.2; FY2021 4,254.5; FY2022 713.2; FY2023 1,268.9; FY2024 1,069.1; FY2025 1,161.3. Two-year FY2024-25 average of ~1,115 is the cleanest base because the FY2024 back-tax payment (RMB 1,140m) and FY2025 tax deferral (RMB 80m paid vs 349m expense) offset. The modelled FY2026 owner FCF of ~RMB 1.1bn (7.8% of revenue) ties to that average.

scenario_narratives.base: A solvent fee business carrying a dead parent's name. Revenue compounds 3-4% near term from third-party signings and fee-collection programmes, fading to 2%; the after-concession EBITDA margin holds near 11% as cost control offsets labour inflation and the ~1% of revenue lost to owner concessions and receivables impairment persists. The liquidators' stake sale eventually completes but changes little operationally. No dividend is modelled; cash accumulates. Terminal value binds at the 12x cap.
scenario_narratives.bull: PAG (or a successor bidder) closes the 51% purchase in FY2026-27 and installs professional governance; the mandatory general offer passes and the brand is rebuilt. Stalled related-party contracted GFA partly converts, concessions and impairments normalise, value-added services grow double digits, and the margin recovers to 13% by FY2030. The RMB 13.4bn court judgments against the parent remain a free option valued at zero.
scenario_narratives.bear: The sale process fails a second time or the buyer proves unable to restore confidence. Legacy Evergrande residential estates vote the manager out as owner committees form, taking revenue down ~7% over FY2027-29 before stabilising at 1% growth; concessions needed to collect arrears and impairments on lengthening receivables push the margin to 8.5%. Zero debt and RMB 3.7bn cash mean this is a shrinking annuity, not a solvency event.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Value the fee stream the business actually produces, after every cash cost of collecting it (owner concessions, impairments, leases), at a CNY-built cost of equity, and add the unrestricted cash. Charge the Evergrande overhang once -- in the bear path and its 30% weight -- and give nothing for the RMB 13.4bn recovery claims or the stalled related-party pipeline. The result is a probability-weighted value in HKD comparable to the HKEX price.
key_risks_to_valuation: Change-of-control outcome: a PAG deal would trigger a mandatory general offer at an undisclosed stake price; a failed process prolongs the overhang. Neither is priced beyond the scenario weights.
Collections: owner concessions (RMB 78m in H1 FY2026, +98%) and impairments (RMB 144m, +111%) are both rising; the base margin assumes they plateau near 1% of revenue combined.
Float cash: RMB 3.7bn cash is added in full although net current assets are only RMB 645m; it is operating float as much as surplus.
Fee regulation caps pricing; growth depends on GFA conversion and value-added mix.
CNY/HKD: a 5% RMB depreciation moves the HKD value ~5%.
No dividend and 5-10% PRC withholding tax on any future upstreaming; the cash is trapped onshore until a payout policy exists.

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API at inputs.price_as_of; 52-week range HKD 0.72-1.70. FX: Yahoo CNYHKD=X at the date in inputs.fx_note.
data_sources.financials: 6666.HK_Metrics.csv (FY2019-FY2025 annual, H1 FY2023-H1 FY2026 interim, RMB millions) built from the HKEX annual and interim reports in Extracted/; FY2025 annual report notes 13 (finance costs), 14 (income tax), 15 (EPS), 7 (segments); H1 FY2026 interim report (balance sheet 30 June 2026, note 9 finance costs, substantial-shareholder table, Potential Transaction section).
data_sources.qualitative: 6666.HK_Analysis.json (2026-10-24): bull/bear axes, PAG exclusivity, stalled related-party GFA, Deposit Pledge Incident litigation.

inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 annual report: no share options granted, exercised or outstanding under the 2021 Share Option Scheme; no share-based payment expense in the cash flow statement. SBC-zero market; rows kept explicit at 0%.
inputs.share_count_basis: 10,810,811,000 ordinary shares in issue at 30 June 2026 (H1 FY2026 interim, substantial-shareholder table and EPS note); no options, no convertibles, no treasury shares, so basic = fully diluted. Held flat: no SBC and no planned issuance.
inputs.fx_note: Statements and flows in RMB (ISO CNY); HKEX quote in HKD. fx_rate is HKD per 1 CNY = 1.1746 (Yahoo CNYHKD=X, 2026-10-23T15:18Z). Direction check: RMB 1.00/share x 1.1746 = HKD 1.17/share. No dual listing exists for a parity check; RMB is a managed currency and CNYHKD has moved within 1.05-1.18 over five years, so the rate is a modest source of error relative to the operating scenarios.
inputs.price_note: HKEX regular close (16:08 HKT); not an after-hours print. 52-week range HKD 0.72-1.70.
inputs.net_debt_note: Cash and cash equivalents RMB 3,691.7m at 30 June 2026 (interim CF statement); restricted cash of RMB 127.6m (insurance-agency regulatory funds, local-government service deposits, litigation preservation) EXCLUDED from cash as not distributable. Borrowings nil at 30 June 2026 and 31 Dec 2025. Lease liabilities (RMB 90.2m) excluded from net debt under lease treatment (B). Caveat: this cash is partly the property-manager float -- contract liabilities RMB 2,317m and payables fund it; net current assets were only RMB 645m at 30 June 2026 (RMB 87.5m at FY2025). It is counted in full, as the operating liabilities are not debt, but in a run-off it would not all be distributable.
inputs.wacc_rationale: Built in CNY, the currency of the flows. China 10-year CGB ~1.8% + beta 1.2 x China ERP ~6.8% = 10.0% cost of equity; zero borrowings so WACC = cost of equity = 10.0%. Same rate in all three scenarios: the Evergrande-specific risks (related-party contagion on collections, change-of-control instability, stalled contracted GFA) are charged ONCE, in the bear driver path and a 30% bear weight, not stacked as a WACC premium.
inputs.lease_treatment: (B) leases as operating cost: FY2025 lease principal RMB 35.7m + lease interest RMB 2.5m = RMB 38.1m (0.28% of revenue) charged inside EBIT via lease_cost_pct_path; lease liabilities excluded from net debt; D&A path is ex right-of-use depreciation (FY2025 total D&A RMB 129.7m less ~RMB 36m ROU = ~0.7% of revenue).
inputs.nci_treatment: Consolidated flows; non-controlling interests deducted ONCE in the equity bridge at book (RMB 332.1m at 30 June 2026). NCI share of profit is small (RMB 22.6m FY2025, a loss of RMB 13.8m in H1 FY2026) so book is a fair proxy. FY0 tie: adjusted EBITDA 1,490 - D&A 130 = 1,360 ~ reported PBT 1,358; x (1-26%) = 1,007 vs reported profit 1,009 (attributable 986.6 + NCI 22.6).
inputs.ebitda_definition: Reported FY2025 EBITDA RMB 1,612.8m (11.8% margin) LESS 'other finance costs' of RMB 122.6m, which the finance-costs note (FY2025 AR note 13; H1 FY2026 note 9) defines as concessions granted to individual property owners to settle service fees and historical arrears -- a recurring cash cost of collection, not interest. Net margin 10.9% in FY2025 and ~10.5% in H1 FY2026 (concessions RMB 77.9m in the half, up 98%). The margin path is therefore an after-concession margin; impairment losses on receivables (RMB 151.3m FY2025) are already inside operating profit.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF component DCF (non-US adaptations: CNY flows vs HKD quote, lease treatment B, NCI in bridge, SBC-zero, excluded interest income). ROUTING: not the distressed/receivership row -- the receivership is the former PARENT's (China Evergrande Group, wound up Jan 2024, delisted Aug 2025). This entity is a solvent, cash-generative fee business: zero borrowings, RMB 3.7bn cash, owners' equity positive since H1 FY2024 and RMB 2,129m at 30 June 2026, no pledged assets, no material contingent liabilities. The RMB 13.4bn guarantee exposure that drove equity negative in FY2021-23 was enforced and fully provided in 2021; it is a closed loss, not an open contingent liability, and the court judgments obtained against the parent for recovery (RMB 9.5m collected to date) are carried at ZERO -- a free option noted in the bull narrative, not in the bridge. Not the NAV row either: NTA is ~RMB 0.20/share against a RMB ~0.91 price; the value is the fee stream. LIVE CORPORATE ACTION: the liquidators are selling the 51.016% controlling stake; a Guangdong Tourism exclusivity collapsed June 2026 and a PAG exclusivity (announced ~30 Sept 2026) runs to ~27 Oct 2026, with no binding agreement or price disclosed. A completed sale would trigger a mandatory general offer under the HK Takeovers Code at the stake price, which is unknown. With no price to anchor to, the three-scenario operating frame is kept and the deal lives in the narratives and weights; if a binding SPA with a price is announced, re-route to deal-completes vs deal-breaks weighting. Horizon 10 years to keep the terminal share down on a slow-growth, fee-regulated business. Discounting is end-of-year from FY2025 as FY0 although 10 months of FY2026 have elapsed -- folder convention, slightly conservative. Cash tax rate 26% normalised (statutory 25%, FY2025 effective 25.7%); FY2025 cash tax paid was only RMB 80m against RMB 349m expense (tax-payable build) and FY2024 was RMB 1,140m (back-tax catch-up), so neither cash year is a repeatable base and the component build uses the normalised rate. PRC dividend withholding tax (5-10%) is not charged because the company pays no dividend; it would apply to any future upstreaming.

bear.rationale: Stake sale fails again or passes to an owner who strips management; owner committees on legacy Evergrande estates vote the manager out, revenue shrinks ~7% over FY2027-29; concessions and impairments rise toward 2.5% of revenue and the margin settles at 8.5%. Working-capital capture set to 0%: on falling revenue the receivables release (19% of revenue) is offset by the unwinding prepaid-fee float (contract liabilities 17% of revenue), and receivables in this case are impaired rather than collected, so no mechanical inflow is credited. Not a solvency case: zero debt and RMB 3.7bn cash mean the equity survives.

base.growth_rationale: FY2025 +7.2%, H1 FY2026 +4.5%; GFA under management 603m sqm (+1.2% YoY) so growth is coming from collection improvement and value-added services rather than area. 43m sqm of third-party signings per half (~RMB 1.0bn saturated annual revenue) are being offset by churn on legacy Evergrande residential projects.
base.margin_rationale: After-concession EBITDA margin 10.9% FY2025, ~10.5% H1 FY2026; held near 11% -- cost control offsets labour inflation, receivables impairment stays ~1% of revenue, owner concessions persist.
base.wc_rationale: Trade receivables grew RMB 64m in FY2025 and RMB 273m in H1 FY2026 while contract liabilities fell RMB 307m; growth consumes cash, so capture is negative. Receivables 19% of revenue vs contract liabilities 17%.
base.terminal_rationale: Cap 12x owner FCF: fee-regulated, labour-intensive, stigmatised brand; HK-listed property managers trade 8-14x earnings. Gordon at 10%/2% would be 12.75x, so the cap binds narrowly.

bull.rationale: Change of control to a credible institutional owner closes; brand stigma fades, some of the ~150m sqm of stalled related-party contracted GFA converts, owner concessions and impairments fall back toward 0.5% of revenue, value-added services (community living +10.7%, to-home +40%, leasing +42%) lift mix. Margin recovers to 13%, still below the 18-19% pre-collapse level.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 12x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% house default to 30%: the controlling shareholder is in liquidation, the board states it cannot assess the impact of related-party issues on collections, one stake-sale exclusivity has already collapsed, and ~150m sqm of contracted GFA is stalled. Bull cut to 20% because it needs several independent things to go right -- a completed change of control, brand recovery, and margin repair -- none of which is in evidence yet. Base 50%.
probability_weighted.band_note: House and street coincide (SBC immaterial): the band collapsed, so band_position is null rather than a degenerate 0.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
